definitions.database_totals: Database table row counts; races includes scheduled race rows. result_races counts distinct races with a result row. Driver and constructor totals are metadata catalog records; per-season drivers and constructors count distinct entrants in race results.
definitions.telemetry: Telemetry sessions are exported session JSON files. drivers_in_sessions sums driver entries across sessions. distinct_drivers is unique driver codes within source. speed_samples counts individual values in each driver speed array, one channel only, so it is a reproducible telemetry density measure, not total values across all telemetry channels.
